exposure: Estimated fetal weight (EFW) categories based on universal third-trimester ultrasound: 30-70th percentile (reference), 90-95th percentile, >95th percentile, and >99th percentile
outcome: Composite adverse perinatal outcome 1 (CAO1): admission to neonatal intensive care unit, Apgar score < 7 at 5 min, and arterial cord pH < 7.1
Composite adverse perinatal outcome 2 (CAO2): stillbirth, neonatal death, and hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy
cohort: Pregnant women with singleton pregnancies and an estimated due date between January 2014 and September 2019 at a single tertiary maternity unit in the UK
finding: Fetuses with EFW > 95th percentile on third-trimester ultrasound had a significantly increased risk of CAO1 and CAO2, while those with EFW 90-95th percentile had a less pronounced increase in CAO1 risk.
